text: Aligned shared-score GLRMs, independent direct sums, and hub-aligned studies are different row-semantic families with no implicit conversion. Block loss scaling is an estimand: observed-entry sums retain block size and original loss units, while mean-observed loss removes observed-cell count before a mandatory positive importance; no automatic variance-standardization claim is made. Shared row-code penalties are owned and charged once by the aligned program. Block graph/TV operators act on expanded natural-parameter coordinates and derive their adjoints algebraically. Partial multiblock encoding is an explicit identity-preserving compiler to one fixed-decoder convex code problem, not an untyped concatenation API.
